annotations.text:
Five pages plus About, dark editorial direction.

Every fact only you know is in [BRACKETS] — years, roles, education, results, and the Sano-J live URL. [EXPAND: …] marks a paragraph waiting for the detail that makes it worth reading.

Client-site screenshots are honest empty frames, not fake screenshots: both sites really exist, so a drawn stand-in would misrepresent them.

Tronk's repository is private, so that link is replaced by a note. The hero, portrait and macro photographs are greyscale stand-ins for yours.

The Resume artboard carries a @media print block: on paper it inverts to ink on white, drops the nav, footer and download button, and sets 11pt body type on A4. That print stylesheet is what produces the PDF — there is no second file to keep in sync.
